prose: Latent Space's AINews digest leads with AMD buying World Labs for $8.2B (the official post is coy, but AMD being public reveals the price) and highlights what AMD is actually getting: Atlas, World Labs' first-of-its-kind omni model that predicts a new camera view from 2D images - essentially solving sparse reconstruction by combining generative models with multiview geometry, outperforming even specialized state-of-the-art models. Fei-Fei Li's reflection post traces the buildout: leading image/video/spatial-reconstruction training teams since 2024, plus the SceniX acquisition for robotics simulation. Atlas's predicted uses span RL environments for robotics, scene generation for therapy and entertainment, and real-world reconstruction for real estate, design, and construction. The digest notes it checked 12 subreddits and 544 Twitter accounts for the period 9/26-9/28.
highlights: AINews leads with AMD's $8.2B World Labs acquisition, price known because AMD is public
Atlas: an omni model that predicts new camera views from 2D images, effectively solving sparse reconstruction
Combines generative models with multiview geometry, beating specialized state of the art
